name: Rain
description: Upgraded rain with gravity-accelerated streak physics, chromatic droplet lensing, HDR bloom on light sources, fog layers, and splash particles. Bass drives intensity, mouse creates wind gusts, depth controls droplet perspective. 2026-11-21: drops fall downward at size-dependent terminal velocities with exposure-length tails, each streak refracts the photo through a water-cylinder lens (Snell), and the mist follows Beer-Lambert extinction on scene depth.
